svg.title: 48. Inner ankle muscle stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Sit with one leg extended and the heel supported. Loop the strap around the front of the foot. Pull gently so the sole turns a little outwards away from the other foot.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/blob/main/exercises/Posterior_Tibialis_Stretch.json
